# Name Purpose

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](gmeow-NamePurpose.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamePurpose>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The purpose/kind of a whole appellation (legal, birth, chosen, professional, deadname, …). A value, not a [`PersonName`](gmeow-PersonName.md) subclass; a person may simultaneously bear several co-equal names of different purposes.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](gmeow-NamePurpose.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
